headline: US futures point to lower open as tech weakness and Nvidia earnings loom alongside key US retail sales and industrial data
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) fall 0.56%, Dow futures (@YM) lose 0.63%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) slip 0.68% and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) decline 0.74% amid tech pressure and pre-Nvidia (NVDA) selling
- Nvidia (NVDA) is set to report after the close, with traders focused on AI demand signals and tighter China chip access after the Commerce Department moved to close a remote-access loophole
- Home Depot (HD) and Walt Disney (DIS) report earnings before the bell, setting up potential moves in consumer and retail-related names
- US retail sales data are due at 8:30 AM ET, with industrial production and capacity utilization scheduled for 9:15 AM ET as key macro volatility catalysts
- European equities trade weaker, with the DAX (@DY) and EuroStoxx 50 (@EX) down around 1.2%
- Asian markets are mostly lower, led by a 1.3% drop in the Nikkei (@NKD) and nearly 2% slide in the KOSPI on AI-sector pressure and new US restrictions on advanced chips to China
- Brent (@QA) and WTI (@CL) crude prices edge slightly higher even as supply-surplus concerns linger
- Early pre-market coverage from Reuters, Bloomberg and CNBC notes no major large-cap movers with clear catalysts, with small-cap action dominated by low-float names lacking fundamental drivers
